summary.intent: Implement the API cleanups proposed in GitHub issue #712 (cross-referencing the related #719 concurrency-cleanup triage) across the mailbox, registry, content, and pin-store services.
summary.outcome: Applied cleanup edits to advisory-lock.ts, registry.service.ts, content.service.ts, mailbox.service.ts, pin-store.ts, and fake-repo.ts; fixed two integration test hooks broken by the change, added a regression test for a new 503 mapping (verified via negative control), ran typecheck/lint/full unit suite (65/65 passing) and relevant integration tests, then created a feature branch and committed the work with a signed commit.

repo: KuboAddResult.Size and similar helper types in apps/api/src/registry/pin-store.ts are file-local, not shared — confirmed by grepping for consumers before editing.

Integration test gate harnesses in registry.service.integration.test.ts and mailbox.service.integration.test.ts (and account.service.integration.test.ts) use a save/insert interception hook pattern that must be kept in sync with service internals — the cleanup required renaming the hook to afterPinInsert and re-pointing it at repo.insert.
apps/api integration tests require a local Postgres/docker stack to be running; this needs to be checked before assuming integration failures are code bugs.
workflow: For behavior-changing fixes (e.g. new 503 error mapping), add a regression test and validate it with a negative control: confirm it fails on pre-fix code, then confirm it passes after restoring the fix.
Before editing shared-looking types/utilities, grep for all consumers and check test mocks/fakes (e.g. FakeRepository) for support of the operations being introduced (like `insert`).
Commits touching signed/1Password-gated commit flow should be run with a timeout guard in case the signing prompt hangs.

friction: GitHub issue #712 view failed initially and needed a retry.
Integration tests initially failed due to a stale save-hook name/target that didn't match the refactored insert path — required tracing hook declarations across both gate test files before fixing.
Had to check for an existing zero-commit branch and working tree status before creating the new feature branch, adding extra verification steps.
open_items: Feature branch was committed locally but not pushed or opened as a PR yet.

The #719 triage doc may list additional cleanup items beyond advisory-lock/registry/content/mailbox/pin-store that weren't covered in this session — worth checking against the original triage memory for remaining scope.
